profile.name: Samuel S. Adedeji
profile.bioQuote: I've developed a deep appreciation for the role culture plays in shaping aesthetics and functionality.
bioParagraphs: My name is Samuel "Utidex" Adedeji, a freelance designer with over five years of experience in brand identity, strategy, visual design, and print media. I create design solutions that balance visual appeal with functional impact across diverse projects.
Outside design, I enjoy sci-fi films, good music, exploring AI automation, and on a lighter note, fried plantain with chocolate.

hero.title: Design What's Next.
hero.subtitle: Creating meaningful experiences, intelligent systems and growth opportunities for people and brands.
